takes.title: Jumps, kicks, and punches
takes.actionDescription: The performer crouches into jumps, takes short repositioning steps, and alternates kicks and punching arm actions.

takes.sourceDescription: walk, squats, run, stretch, jumps, punches, and drinking
takes.title: Squats, running, and upper-body actions
takes.actionDescription: The performer moves through walking, squats, and running, then mixes overhead stretches and jumps with punches and a hand-to-mouth gesture.

takes.sourceDescription: walking, running, jumping, kicking, and stretching
takes.title: Run, jump, kick, and stretch sequence
takes.actionDescription: The performer alternates walking and running with jumps and raised-leg kicks, then stretches and walks away.

takes.sourceDescription: walking, stretching, punching, chopping, and drinking
takes.title: Stretching and upper-body mime
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks and reaches overhead, then alternates forward punches, downward chopping motions, and a hand-to-mouth gesture.

takes.sourceDescription: walking, jumping, jumping jacks,  jumping on one foot, punching, chopping,
takes.title: Jumping jacks and arm strikes
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks between jumps and jumping jacks, balances briefly on one leg, and follows with punches and chopping arm motions.

takes.sourceDescription: walking, running, kicking, punching, knee kicking, and stretching
takes.title: Running, kicking, and knee lifts
takes.actionDescription: The performer switches between walking and running, adds kicks, punches, and driving knee lifts, and stretches between efforts.

takes.sourceDescription: walking, swinging arms, stretching, jumping on one leg, and jumping
takes.title: Arm swings and single-leg jumps
takes.actionDescription: The performer steps and turns while swinging and lifting the arms, then adds a series of one-leg and two-leg jumps.

takes.sourceDescription: walking, squats, stretching, kicking, and punching
takes.title: Squats, stretches, and strikes
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks between squats and stretches, including an overhead reach, then mixes kicks and punching arm movements into the sequence.

takes.title: Walk, sit, look, and stand
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks into position, lowers into a seated posture, changes head and arm position, and rises into a walk.

takes.title: Walking with an upper-body stretch
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks in, raises both arms and reaches to either side while standing, then lowers the arms and walks through a turn.

takes.sourceDescription: walking around, walk up ladder, step down ladder
takes.title: Walk and mime a ladder climb
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks into position, alternates raised hands and stepping motions as if climbing a ladder, then steps back down and walks away.

takes.sourceDescription: bouncing basketball, shooting basketball, dribble basketball, two handed dribble
takes.title: Basketball handling and shooting
takes.actionDescription: The performer shifts between basketball dribbling and shooting motions, varying the hand position and bending through the knees before releasing upward.

takes.title: Walk, sit, and gesture
takes.actionDescription: The performer walks into position and sits, makes a series of one- and two-handed gestures including a hand near the head, then stands again.
